Utrecht* 
* Hbo, Wo
* 32 \- 36 uur
* Schaal 10, Schaal 11 / €3\.496 \- €6\.275 (bruto)
* Development en testing

  
Solliciteer voor 14 oktober 2026
  
**Dit ga je doen**
------------------


Jij versterkt team TEC, het data\- en integratieteam dat systemen binnen de Rechtspraak met elkaar laat praten. Als Java/Kotlin developer bouw jij de datakoppelingen die dat mogelijk maken. Soms komt de informatie voor één toepassing uit vijf of zes verschillende bronnen. Daar zit de grote puzzel: waar haal je welke data vandaan, hoe breng je die goed bij elkaar en hoe zorg je dat andere teams ermee verder kunnen?
  

  

Het aantal datavragen groeit. Collega\-teams kloppen vaker bij TEC aan en de lat ligt hoog: gegevens moeten soms binnen een paar seconden beschikbaar zijn. Voor jou betekent dat technisch uitdagend werk met Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, OCP, AMQ en MongoDB. Je bouwt oplossingen die een hoge snelheid aankunnen, stabiel blijven én data breed beschikbaar maken binnen de Rechtspraak.
  

  

Je werkt met zo’n acht à negen collega’s: developers, testers, ontwerpers, een product owner en scrum master. Een team waarin techniek volop onderwerp van gesprek is en je de ruimte krijgt om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. De backend is jouw basis, maar daar hoeft het niet bij te blijven. Jullie gaan bijvoorbeeld ook schermen bouwen voor het beheren en raadplegen van referentiegegevens. Angular al in de vingers? Mooi. Nog niet? Dan kun je het hier leren.
  

  

Is data\-integratie helemaal jouw ding? En vind je het leuk om samen te werken met collega’s die net zo van technologie houden als jij? Dan zit je goed bij TEC: een technisch gedreven club waar kennis delen en samen nieuwe dingen uitproberen vanzelfsprekend zijn.
  
**Dit krijg je**
----------------


* Schaal 10, Schaal 11
  

€3\.496 \- €6\.275 (bruto)

* 32 \- 36 uur

Om te beginnen een leuke, informele werksfeer. We houden de lijnen graag kort! En je arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn prima geregeld volgens de CAO Rijk. Wat belangrijke punten op een rij:
  

* Contract: een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 36 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
* Salaris: je komt terecht in salarisschaal 10 of 11 (maximaal € 6\.275,94 per maand bij een werkweek van 36 uur). Inschaling vindt plaats op basis van je werkervaring.
* Keuzebudget: 16,5% van je jaarsalaris (maximaal € 1\.008 per maand) om je eigen arbeidsvoorwaarden samen te stellen. Zoals het kopen van verlof, het aanschaffen van een fiets of het verduurzamen van je woning.
* Doorgroeimogelijkheden: je functie zit vol mogelijkheden om je kennis verder uit te breiden en je persoonlijke ontwikkeling te stimuleren. En bij onze IVO Academie kun je allerlei trainingen en opleidingen doen.
* Werk\-privébalans: je bent vrij om je werkdagen flexibel in te delen. Zo kun je deels vanuit huis werken. We dragen € 750 bij aan het inrichten van een comfortabele thuiswerkplek.
* Vakanties en vrije dagen: je hebt 144 vakantie\- en 64 keuzebudget\-uren op basis van een 36\-urige werkweek. Dat zijn dus in totaal 26 dagen.
* Gratis OV: je krijgt van ons een OV\-chipkaart voor je woon\-werkverkeer.
* Pensioen: je bouwt je pensioen op bij het ABP, een van de grootste pensioenfondsen van Nederland. Ook dat is dus goed geregeld.
* Leuke activiteiten: een teamdag, borrelmiddagen, een after summer\-feest … er gebeurt van alles. Of organiseer ook zelf iets met je collega’s, van padel tot yoga of een pubquiz.

Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden vind je op www.p\-direkt.nl.
  
**Dit vragen wij**
------------------


* 4 à 5 jaar ervaring met Java/Kotlin binnen data\-integratie
* Ervaring met Spring Boot
* Ervaring met werken in een containeromgeving, zoals OCP
* Kennis van message brokers, zoals AMQ
* Kennis van MongoDB

Kom je bij ons werken, dan vragen we ook altijd een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag.

Bij IVO Rechtspraak werken rond de 1\.000 bevlogen, trotse en betrokken professionals. Samen ontwikkelen en beheren we de digitale systemen voor de rechtspraak. * ### **Wat ga je doen?**

#### **Met jouw energie kan het**


	+ Je draagt bij aan betrouwbare digitale ondersteuning van elektriciteits\- en gasaansluitingen voor huishoudens en kleine bedrijven.
	+ Je helpt Agile teams die werken met Java\-, SAP\-, Mendix\- en Flowable\-applicaties om samen betere resultaten te behalen.
	+ Je kunt daarbij rekenen op goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een flexibel arbeidsvoorwaardenbudget, een solide pensioenregeling en volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling.#### **Zo ga jij deze uitdaging aan**


De Beheer\- en Verbeterketen Kleinverbruik zorgt voor de digitale ondersteuning van elektriciteits\- en gasaansluitingen. Denk aan het aanvragen, aanpassen, verplaatsen of afsluiten van een aansluiting en aan het plaatsen en vervangen van meters.


Als Release Train Engineer werk je binnen twee clusters van deze keten. Je helpt de clusters om verder te groeien in hun samenwerking, werkwijzen en resultaten. Daarbij houd je overzicht over wat er speelt, breng je mensen en belangen bij elkaar en zorg je voor duidelijkheid over doelen en prioriteiten. Je werkt nauw samen met de Agile teams, de andere RTE en verschillende stakeholders binnen Enexis.


Dit zijn jouw verantwoordelijkheden:


	+ Je houdt de focus op het leveren van businesswaarde en maatschappelijke impact.
	+ Je helpt de twee clusters verder groeien en volwassen worden in hun Agile manier van werken.
	+ Je stimuleert gewenst gedrag, eigenaarschap en een open samenwerkingscultuur.
	+ Je neemt initiatief en zorgt voor continue verbetering van werkwijzen en resultaten.
	+ Je toont verbindend leiderschap en creëert duidelijkheid en vertrouwen.
	+ Je communiceert gemakkelijk met verschillende mensen en niveaus binnen de organisatie.
* ### **Functie\-eisen**

#### **Zo pak jij het aan**


Je werkt met aandacht voor mensen én resultaat. Je geeft ruimte waar dat kan en biedt richting waar dat nodig is. Door goed te luisteren, verschillende perspectieven samen te brengen en helder te communiceren, krijg je mensen in beweging. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, bent zichtbaar in de samenwerking en krijgt energie van continu verbeteren.


Verder heb je:


	+ Hbo/wo werk\- en denkniveau
	+ Ervaring als Release Train Engineer of in een vergelijkbare rol.
	+ Ervaring met SAFe en/of Agile werken.
	+ Affiniteit met IT en digitale dienstverlening.
* ### **Team \& cultuur**

#### **Je zet je schouders eronder met**


Jouw collega’s binnen de Beheer\- en Verbeterketen Kleinverbruik. Deze keten bestaat uit 16 Agile teams, verdeeld over vier clusters. De teams werken aan digitale oplossingen voor aansluitingen, meters, energiegebruik, klantinteractie en flexibiliteit.


Je werkt met name binnen twee clusters en werkt daarin nauw samen met een andere Release Train Engineer. Er heerst een prettige werksfeer waarin samenwerking, open communicatie en ruimte voor ieders inbreng belangrijk zijn. Verschillende teams werken met Java\-, SAP\-, Mendix\- en Flowable\-applicaties. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat de digitale ondersteuning van het kleinverbruik betrouwbaar en steeds beter wordt.


We vinden het belangrijk dat je je bij ons thuis voelt. We zijn allemaal anders en het mooie daarvan is dat we elkaar vanuit die verschillen aanvullen. We hebben elkaars perspectieven en meningen nodig voor een succesvolle energietransitie! Lees hier mee over ons beleid op diversiteit en inclusie.
* ### **Wat krijg je van ons?**

#### **En wij steken natuurlijk ook energie in jou**


Bij Enexis werk je in de voorhoede van een van de grootste uitdagingen van onze tijd: de energietransitie. Daarbij zorgen we goed voor je. Dat begint met een uitgebreid welkomstpakket en \-programma om je collega’s te leren kennen. En met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden:

	+ Inclusief de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden kan je salaris oplopen tot € 10\.488,\- bruto per maand. Je ontvangt namelijk 28,7% bovenop je salaris (8% vakantiegeld, een 13e maand van 10,7% en een persoonlijk budget van 10%). Dit kun je laten uitbetalen wanneer je wilt, of je kunt hier extra verlofdagen van kopen.

	+ Mogelijkheden om hybride te werken, inclusief een door ons ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een thuiswerkvergoeding van € 2,45 netto per dag.
	+ Bijdrage van 70% aan je ABP Keuzepensioen: Enexis betaalt twee derde van de premie, jij draagt een derde bij.

	+ Ruimte om te groeien met ons interne ontwikkelplatform en/of externe opleidingen en trainingen. Of je nu wilt doorgroeien, een carrièreswitch overweegt of je skills verder wilt ontwikkelen: wij stimuleren je om het beste uit jezelf te halen.

Douane

De Douane is een handhavingsdienst, stelt de verschuldigde douanerechten en accijnzen vast en heft en int deze. De geïnde bedragen worden afgedragen aan de Nederlandse schatkist en de EU. De Douane zorgt er ook voor dat de samenleving zo goed mogelijk wordt beschermd tegen onveilige en ongewenste goederen. Cover for Almost every Home

We work at pace, but we trust our people to work in a way that brings out their best. You'll collaborate closely across teams, have real ownership from day one and see the impact you have first-hand with flexible working to help you balance the needs of your role with the rhythm of your life.

We've been recognised as a Great Place to Work UK for seven consecutive years - most recently ranked 29th nationally, jumping 71 places in a single year.

Customer & Claims brings together three connected parts of Homeprotect's business: the shared digital experience customers and partners use across every channel, the tools our operations teams use to support customers directly, and the end-to-end claims journey, from a customer first reporting a loss through to their claim being settled. It's the team most responsible for how Homeprotect actually feels to a customer, whichever door they come through.

Fairer Finance rates us as the UK's most transparent Home Insurer. This team plays a central part in that reputation: the systems you build directly shape how trustworthy and easy Homeprotect feels at the moments that matter most to customers.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead technical delivery within this team and raise the capability of the engineers around them. You'll take ownership of complex, customer-facing systems and claims workflows, make sound architectural decisions with minimal guidance, and be a trusted technical voice for a domain that touches nearly every interaction a customer has with Homeprotect.

Success in this role means the systems you own are reliable, well understood and easy for others to build on, and the engineers around you are visibly better because you're on the team.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Ownership & Delivery

Lead the design, delivery and operation of complex features and systems across the domain, whether that's customer-facing journeys, operational tooling for our support teams, or the claims lifecycle, depending on where you're needed most.
Make significant architectural and technical decisions independently, and document the reasoning behind them so others can build on the work without needing you present.
Lead delivery of complex, often cross-functional initiatives, balancing speed, quality and long-term sustainability.
Identify and address technical debt and risk in the domain before it becomes a business or customer problem.

Product & Business Partnership

Develop a deep understanding of how customers interact with Homeprotect across channels, and of what happens when something goes wrong and a claim is made, and use that understanding to help shape what the team builds.
Partner with the domain's Product Manager and Engineering Manager to spot opportunities and risks early, before they turn into problems.
Bring a domain perspective into technical decisions, and a technical perspective into product decisions, particularly where customer experience and claims handling intersect.

Technical Leadership & Mentoring

Coach and mentor other engineers, raising the technical standard of the team through code review, pairing and everyday guidance.
Be a trusted voice on technical decisions, sought out by others in the team.
Create an environment where less experienced engineers can grow and do their best work.

Continuous Improvement

Drive improvements to engineering practices, testing, deployment and observability within the domain.
Continuously grow your own capability and that of the engineers around you.
Contribute to Homeprotect's wider engineering standards as they mature.

.

Essential

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Proven experience as a senior software engineer, owning delivery of complex systems or cross-functional technical initiatives, not just individual features.
Strong track record of making sound architectural and design decisions with minimal guidance, and clearly explaining the reasoning behind them.
Experience mentoring and raising the technical capability of other engineers, through code review, pairing and everyday coaching.
Comfortable working across the stack relevant to customer-facing systems: frontend and backend, or deep expertise in one with a working knowledge of the other.
Strong hands-on experience in at least one modern backend language, such as C# or Java (or a comparable object-oriented language), and familiarity with a modern frontend framework.
Deep, hands-on understanding of modern software engineering practices: continuous integration and deployment, automated testing, observability and cloud-native development.
Experience operating production systems, in a public cloud environment such as Azure or GCP, that need to be reliable, secure and performant.
Strong communication skills, able to build trust with both engineers and non-technical colleagues.

Desirable

Experience in general insurance, financial services or another regulated industry.
Experience building customer-facing digital journeys at scale, or systems supporting operational or customer service teams.
Experience with claims handling, case management, or similarly regulated end-to-end business processes.
Exposure to event-driven or distributed systems.
Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve engineering productivity.

Benefits

We want you to feel rewarded, supported and set up to thrive throughout your career with us.

Learning and Growth:
We invest in your development through structured learning, mentoring, buddying, on-the-job experience and cross-functional projects. We support role-relevant professional qualifications where they'll make the biggest difference, and our Lunch and Learn sessions to help you stay connected to what’s going on right across the business.

Health and Wellbeing:
Your wellbeing matters here. We offer private healthcare through BUPA, an Employee Assistance Programme covering legal, financial and counselling support for you, a Wellbeing Centre with online tools and resources, regular wellbeing seminars and workshops, annual flu jabs and an annual eye care voucher.

Financial Security and Reward:
We offer an annual discretionary bonus scheme upto 30% of your base pay, life insurance at four times your salary, and a pension with Aegon. You'll also receive a significant discount on Homeprotect home insurance - with a friends and family discount too, and a staff referral bonus when someone you recommend joins the team.

Time Off:
25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to buy or sell up to five additional days each year.

Genuine Flexible Working
We trust our people to work in a way that best suits them - with flexible working to balance the needs of your role with the rhythm of your life. We ask that everyone comes into the office at least once a week, as we believe in-person connection is important for collaboration, culture and building great relationships. You'll receive a homeworking starter kit from day one and can claim towards additional home office equipment within your first six months.

Purpose and Community:
We care about more than just the work. Through our charity partnership with Refuge, the UK's largest specialist domestic abuse charity and regular social, wellbeing and charitable events throughout the year, there are plenty of ways to connect, give back and feel part of something bigger.

UNIQUE AS STANDARD

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively encourage applications from all backgrounds. We believe in celebrating difference - everything that makes both our customers and our people unique. We consider visa sponsorship on a case by case basis for the right candidate, so please don't let that stop you from applying.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any extra help with your application or have any requirements at any stage of the recruitment journey, we want the process to work for you.

Your data will be maintained in line with our recruitment data privacy policy.

As an FCA regulated insurer, doing the right thing isn't a compliance requirement - it's simply how we work. All colleagues are expected to uphold the FCA Individual Conduct Rules (1–6) and act with integrity, due skill and care, openness with regulators and a genuine commitment to delivering good outcomes for our customers.

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

WSP is looking for an experienced Software Developer (Cloud & Data) to join our industry-leading Intelligent Infrastructure team. We provide technical professional services to transport clients throughout the UK and overseas to deliver tangible value through technology enabled change.

Join us and make a real-world difference by helping to deliver crucial projects for public sector clients, such as using big data to help the DfT provide better rail services, helping road safety officers visualise accident data geospatially, or gathering vital transport planning data using AI-enabled traffic cameras that distinguish and count the different modes of transport.

As a WSP Software Developer (Cloud & Data), you will play a key role in technical delivery while also leading tasks within a team to provide quality assurance, consultancy, and advisory services on client-facing projects. In addition to challenging and stimulating projects, you will be able to access a range of benefits, including targeted professional development and training to help you grow and develop at WSP.

A Little More About Your Role…

Design, build and maintain secure, scalable software, cloud and data solutions using industry best practices, ensuring security and compliance.
Scope, estimate, and take ownership of delivery for assigned tasks and projects, managing workload and dependencies to deliver within agreed timeframes.
Engage with clients and stakeholders to understand their needs, capture requirements, and ensure a shared understanding of project objectives
Lead technical tasks and work packages, coordinating activities, managing dependencies and providing technical direction to ensure successful delivery of outcomes.
Perform quality assurance reviews of project documentation or consultancy deliverables, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and alignment with best practices and client requirements
Support and maintain new and legacy applications, cloud services and data platforms, ensuring timely and effective resolution of issues while maintaining clear communication with stakeholders.
Provide consultancy and advisory services, guiding clients on software engineering, cloud adoption, data architecture and technical best practices.
Input to the continuous improvement of practice and standards within the team
Maintain and develop your own expertise by staying current with emerging technologies, pursuing relevant certifications, and through continuous learning
Coach and mentor junior colleagues, providing guidance, support, and constructive feedback to help them develop their skills and confidence

Your Team…

This role sits within the Intelligent Infrastructure business and will form a key part of the growing Data, Architecture and Solutions Capability, which is our centre of excellence for digital skills. The Capability team provides a community of colleagues working in and around technology to help you deliver effectively and support your professional development through training, mentoring and opportunities to really stretch your capabilities.
You'll work as part of an Agile team of developers, testers, analysts and transport specialists to design, build, deploy and maintain cloud-based applications, data solutions and digital services. Using technologies such as Python, .NET, Azure, DevOps and AI capabilities enabled through our Microsoft partnership, you'll deliver innovative solutions that help make journeys greener, safer, cheaper and faster.
We operate a hybrid working policy and expect colleagues to spend time on client sites and collaborating with colleagues face-to-face, as well as working from a local office. We have offices across the UK.

What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…

Experience designing, building and supporting enterprise-scale applications and services using ASP.NET and Microsoft Azure, supported by relevant certifications and qualifications. Experience with Python would be highly beneficial.
Experience designing and implementing cloud-native solutions and data-driven applications, including integration, transformation and management of data within cloud environments
Experience working across the Azure platform, with the ability to independently deliver cloud-based solutions whether involving applications, data pipelines, DevOps tooling, automation, integration or other Azure services
Experience of semantic modelling, metadata management and enterprise data architecture, applying these practices to support scalable, governed and reusable data solutions.
Experience applying secure software development practices, including OWASP guidelines, identity and access management, secrets management and basic threat modelling.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and develop practical solutions to complex technical challenges.
Experience working within Agile delivery teams and deploying applications and services through DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines in production environments.
Demonstrable experience of testing throughout the software delivery lifecycle, including unit, integration, ETL, regression and end-to-end testing.
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with experience working directly with clients and customers to provide credible technical advice and guidance.
Experience conducting quality assurance activities and technical reviews to ensure the reliability, maintainability and compliance of software, cloud and data solutions.
Experience providing guidance and applying best practices in cloud architecture, data architecture and software engineering.
A degree in an analytical discipline such as Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, Social Sciences, or equivalent industry experience.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

About Us

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Inclusivity & Belonging

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.

Health & Wellbeing

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.

Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.

Flex your time

To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.

We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

Your development

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

#WeAreWSP

Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity.
